review.why: Builds an SEO content brief from the live top-10 results, the top pages' structure, keyword ideas and the site's own Search Console data.
review.summary: Pulls the live search results, reads the top three pages for table stakes and gaps, gathers keyword ideas and volumes, checks which queries the site already gets impressions for, then assembles a brief: keywords, intent, title and meta, headings with notes, questions, differentiating angle, three to five internal links and a target length.
strengths: Brief comes from what actually ranks, not a generic outline
Flags an existing page that should be expanded instead of writing a new one
Length target follows the ranking median, no padding
cautions: Needs a third-party connector for keyword and Search Console data, with a vendor sign-up link
Without it, falls back to web search only
A bullet list stands in for a brief template
